text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I can't imagine why, but... do the Three 
Goddesses have some business with me?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
They say the gods are greedy— So what is 
it you guys are after?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Come on, say it honestly. ...Well? Go 
right ahead.
